review_scope: All 65 original road parents and their 195 generated damage variants inspected on five four-state contact sheets at native 128-pixel icon resolution.
observations: Damaged states retain the original silhouette with a buckled body section, displaced cover, damaged glazing, missing trim and tilted front wheel.
Critical states expose the chassis and radiator, remove front tyre geometry where present, and fracture or remove glazing.
Wreck states compress the upper structure and add collapsed roof skin; motorcycles and scooters lean onto one side.
Original model families, color identity and manufacturer remain recognizable across each four-state row.
These are original procedural block models. Their art variants are proposed IDs, separate from the 509 primary asset count.
physics: Not implemented or validated by these art exports.
